name: IC Driver Motor — 46V — QFN
description: Motor driver IC cluster featuring 46V surface-mount components in QFN packaging, such as QFN-36-1EP (5x6mm, 0.5mm pitch).
selection_hints: Requires a 46V motor driver IC in an SMD QFN package.
Matching footprint is QFN-36-1EP (5x6mm, 0.5mm pitch with exposed thermal pad).
Target part includes TMC2100-LA from kicad-symbols (Tier B quality).
avoid_when: The design requires non-QFN packaging or through-hole mounting.
The PCB layout cannot accommodate a QFN-36-1EP footprint with thermal vias.
